seen.body: GitHub's 'secondary rate limit ... temporarily blocked from content creation' blocks last several minutes; qew said retry after 60s. Honour Retry-After when given; with none, back off several minutes (escalating on repeats) and print the time at which a rerun is likely to work. Walk: fake answers 403 secondary-limit text without Retry-After; assert the longer wait is recorded and printed.
seen.title: A secondary-limit 403 backs off longer than 60 seconds and prints the realistic resume time
